title: Grateful Dead Live at Folsom Field, U of Colorado on 1972-09-03
lineage: TascamMKII >Korg MR1000 at 1bit/5.6mHZ and cass> Apogee Mini Me>apogeeDAC>LynxOne at 24/96 PCM WAV;  **GEMS** Edit Station at 32bitfloat/88.2kHz Weiss Saracon for SRC and POW-r3 dither to 16 bit/44.1 kHz
source: Composite sources: MR>cass, MR>cass>cass and multi generation sources

ai_review.summary: A three‑set 1972 show with standout performances (Mexicali Blues, China Cat, He's Gone → The Other One → Wharf Rat, Playing in the Band) captured on a soundboard that sounds good overall but has patchy sections.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the musical flow and highlight several classic jams, especially the He’s Gone/Other One/Wharf Rat sequence and the early set gems. The recording is a sound‑board MP3 that many call the best version on the Archive, though a few tracks suffer from patches or need EQ tweaks.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (average ~4.5 stars) while noting occasional recording flaws (average ~3.5). Weighted combination yields a solid 4.2‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally the best‑sounding MP3 version on the Archive; clear overall but some songs have patchy or missing sections and benefit from EQ adjustments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A three‑set monster with a strong early set, an expansive middle, and a memorable third set; occasional missing pieces (Bird Song) and questionable encore noted.

band_member_comments.Phil: Impassioned backing vocals by Phil are highlighted in the third set.
